title: Australia pilot conditional decision register
purpose: Make the verb, protected object and IF conditions inspectable, falsifiable, reversible and time-bounded.

canonical_form.template: [verb] [protected or advanced object] IF [observable conditions, window and uncertainty rule], BY [bounded reversible action], UNTIL [review or expiry condition].
prohibitions: Do not treat modelled exposure as realised adoption.
Do not treat temporal sequence or correlation as causation.
Do not hide a missing condition inside a composite score.
Do not allow a condition to persist without expiry and review.
Do not use a condition to withdraw the continuity floor or coerce an individual.

threshold_policy.rule: Do not invent universal numeric crisis thresholds in the prototype. Set source-specific thresholds before observing outcomes, with baseline distribution, practical significance, uncertainty, warning lead time and error costs.
threshold_policy.minimum_signal: At least two independent measures from different collection processes for escalation beyond evidence review.
threshold_policy.precision: Agent proposal: publish an estimate at relative standard error at or below 25%; mark 25% to 50% directional; suppress above 50%, unavailable or disclosure-blocked. Statistical and ABS review required.

reference_registry.description: Monthly employer-verified occupation-region AI deployment panel.
Quarterly matched employer-worker task and work-design panel.
Monthly or quarterly cohort continuity-floor pulse.
Programme eligibility, capacity, timing, take-up and quality register.
A source-manifest item selected before analysis for the relevant floor domain.
Predeclared uncertainty, suppression, coverage and disclosure rules.
Ethical counterfactual evaluation registered before outcomes are examined.
Time-stamped independent review and decision record.

if_all.test: Occupation score meets a predeclared study-priority threshold
A publishable employment series exists for the occupation and region

counterevidence: Exposure score is stale after material model-capability or task-taxonomy change
Cohort classification cannot be mapped consistently
conditions.bounded_interpretation: The cohort is a priority for measurement and worker engagement, not a prediction of deployment or loss.
conditions.action: Recruit voluntary worker and employer panels and document current task bundles.
conditions.expiry: On a new validated exposure study or classification break
conditions.uncertainty_rule: Display source assumptions and no probability language.
conditions.false_negative_cost: Failure to establish a pre-deployment baseline.

conditions.population: Scoped workers and their employing organisations

if_all.test: A named system is in production in a named workflow with a deployment date
Affected workers report use or workflow interaction, with participation and non-response reported
Usage frequency or affected task share exceeds a predeclared minimum

counterevidence: Worker evidence materially conflicts with employer evidence
conditions.bounded_interpretation: A deployment is active in the measured workflow and cohort. No downstream effect is implied.
conditions.action: Begin prospective redesign and outcome measurement from the deployment date.
conditions.expiry: After one reporting period without corroboration or when deployment ends
conditions.uncertainty_rule: Require both employer and worker evidence; report participation and missingness.
conditions.false_positive_cost: Incorrect attribution of ordinary change to AI.

conditions.population: Workers in a verified deployment workflow

if_all.test: A material, predeclared change in task time or responsibility is observed
if_all.window: Pre-deployment baseline to two consecutive post-deployment quarters

if_all.test: Direction of change is corroborated or conflict is explicitly retained
Human review, override, monitoring and accountability are recorded

counterevidence: Concurrent outsourcing or software replacement explains the redesign
conditions.bounded_interpretation: The measured workflow changed after deployment; causal attribution still depends on a comparison design.
conditions.action: Label the redesign mode, examine worker distributional effects and test alternative explanations.
conditions.owner: Work-design research lead with worker representatives
conditions.uncertainty_rule: Retain disagreement and missingness rather than averaging it away.
conditions.false_negative_cost: Normalising harmful redesign before it is visible.

conditions.population: One scoped occupation, never an aggregate of NERO occupation series

if_all.test: A sustained deviation exceeds a preregistered practical and uncertainty threshold
LFS, longitudinal LFS or Job Mobility direction is consistent when available
No suppression, classification break or material unreconciled revision

counterevidence: Population or migration shift explains movement
conditions.bounded_interpretation: Employment or transition conditions may have changed. The cause remains unknown.
conditions.action: Convene a time-bounded evidence review, collect local qualitative evidence and test confounders.
conditions.expiry: After 30 days unless confirmed with refreshed evidence
conditions.uncertainty_rule: Require independent corroboration and display revisions. Never aggregate NERO series.
conditions.false_positive_cost: False alarm, stigma and wasted response capacity.
conditions.false_negative_cost: Delayed training, income or employment support.

conditions.population: Scoped workers and households where a valid occupation link exists; broader local population otherwise
conditions.geography: National or state for GSS unless SA4 cells pass precision and disclosure; source-native geography for domain context

if_all.test: At least one direct access or cash-flow measure worsens beyond a preregistered threshold
A different official collection supports the same domain and direction
Estimate passes uncertainty and disclosure rules and exclusions are visible

counterevidence: Policy eligibility or reporting change explains administrative series
conditions.bounded_interpretation: A domain may be under pressure in the measured population and period. The result does not establish an AI cause.
conditions.action: Offer voluntary, non-stigmatising support and investigate service capacity. Do not reduce other support.
conditions.owner: Floor-domain owner and community governance group
conditions.review_window: Within 10 business days after a valid release
conditions.expiry: At the next direct measure or after 90 days, whichever comes first
conditions.uncertainty_rule: Two independent collections and a direct access measure are required. Price or spending alone cannot satisfy this condition.
conditions.false_positive_cost: Misdirected services and place or cohort stigma.
conditions.false_negative_cost: Loss of housing, food, energy, mobility, healthcare or connectivity before support arrives.

conditions.population: Workers affected by verified adoption or redesign

if_all.test: Control, meaningful options, voice, time autonomy and ability to refuse are measured and validated
At least two materially distinct pathways have verified eligibility, capacity, timing and income implications
No pathway requires an avoidable breach of the continuity floor

counterevidence: Training lacks places or job pathways
Consent is tied to loss of entitlements
Proxy measures conflict with direct worker reports
conditions.bounded_interpretation: The programme offers measured, feasible alternatives. It does not prove that every person experiences agency.
conditions.action: Fund navigators, paid learning time, portable support and worker-led negotiation of redesign.
conditions.review_window: Quarterly and at each pathway decision
conditions.expiry: When programme capacity, eligibility or labour demand changes
conditions.uncertainty_rule: Keep component measures visible. Do not publish a single agency score until construct validation succeeds.
conditions.false_negative_cost: Withholding useful options and worker power.

conditions.population: Workers and service users in a verified deployment
conditions.geography: Programme site with occupation and region context

if_all.test: Quality-adjusted output or service access improves against a credible comparison
Hours, pay, security, workload and agency do not materially deteriorate, with subgroup results
No affected subgroup shows a credible continuity-floor deterioration
Service quality, price, access or time saved improves for users

counterevidence: Gains accrue only to owners or managers
conditions.bounded_interpretation: This deployment is consistent with shared augmentation gains in the measured period and population.
conditions.action: Scale gradually with gain-sharing, monitoring, worker veto or pause rights and periodic revalidation.
conditions.expiry: After one quarter without complete distributional evidence
conditions.uncertainty_rule: Require absolute and distributional results, not average productivity alone.
conditions.false_positive_cost: Scaling extraction or degraded service as abundance.
conditions.false_negative_cost: Failing to spread a genuinely beneficial design.

conditions.population: A defined deployment cohort and comparison population
conditions.geography: Predeclared programme and comparison regions or organisations

if_all.test: Deployment timing and affected workers or tasks are observed, not inferred
Phased deployment, matched comparison, difference-in-differences or randomised design is valid and ethical
Parallel trends, spillovers, attrition, anticipation, treatment heterogeneity and sensitivity checks pass
Statistical, worker and ethics reviewers approve the bounded claim

conditions.bounded_interpretation: Only the preregistered outcome, population, intervention and period may use causal language.
conditions.action: Publish effect size, uncertainty, assumptions, heterogeneity, harms and replication materials permitted by privacy rules.
conditions.expiry: At material intervention, population or measurement change
conditions.uncertainty_rule: No causal language when any required condition is missing or invalidated.
conditions.false_positive_cost: Misguided policy, stigma and loss of trust.
conditions.false_negative_cost: Delayed adoption of effective protections or beneficial redesign.

condition_evolution_rules.required_action: Re-evaluate each atomic condition, counterevidence item, uncertainty state and expiry. Do not only refresh the headline.
Preserve the previous vintage, recompute affected states and publish whether the decision would have changed.
Set affected conditions to conflicted or stale until a reviewed concordance is available.
Set the state to unmeasured or suppressed. Never inherit the previous green state without a visible stale flag and expiry.
Move the condition to conflicted and suspend escalation until the conflict is resolved or the action is independently justified as precautionary and reversible.
Record action timing, eligibility, take-up and service quality so intervention effects are not mistaken for underlying transition effects.
Return to unmeasured unless fresh evidence satisfies the condition.
